title: Comparison of two measures on open subsets of small balls extends to a Borel set
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ and ν be Borel measures on ℝ^P (Measure (Euclid P)), and let D ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set. Assume μ(K) ≠ ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, and that every w ∈ D has some ε > 0 such that ν(W) ≤ μ(W) for every open set W ⊆ B_ε(w). Then ν(D) ≤ μ(D).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (D : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → MeasurableSet D → (∀ w ∈ D, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball w ε → ν W ≤ μ W) → ν D ≤ μ D
